name: Hide price and add to cart Lite
author: Woo Managers

sections.description:
Hide Price and Add to Cart Lite for WooCommerce allows you to hide product prices and the Add to Cart button using flexible rule-based control. This plugin is perfect for wholesale stores, B2B WooCommerce shops, catalog mode websites, membership-based pricing stores, and quotation-based businesses. With an easy-to-use admin interface, you can create multiple rules to control who can see product prices and purchase options — no coding required.

Why Use Hide Price and Add to Cart Lite?

Many WooCommerce stores require conditional pricing visibility. You may want to:

  • Hide prices for guest users
  • Replace “Add to Cart” with “Request a Quote”
  • Show pricing only to logged-in users
  • Create a catalog-only WooCommerce store
  • Restrict purchasing by user roles

This plugin makes it simple and flexible.

Key Features

Create Multiple Hide Rules
– Create unlimited rules to hide price and Add to Cart button
– Control visibility based on conditions

Hide Price with Custom Text
– Hide product price completely
– Replace price with custom text (e.g., Login to see price, Call for price, Request a Quote)
– Leave price area empty if needed

Hide Add to Cart Button
– Remove Add to Cart button
– Replace with custom text
– Replace with a custom link button (Contact page, Quote form, WhatsApp link, etc.)

Advanced Targeting Options
Apply rules based on:

  • Specific Products
  • Product Categories
  • Product Tags
  • User Roles (Guests, Customers, Wholesalers, etc.)

Lightweight and Performance Friendly
– Built following WordPress coding standards
– Optimized for speed and compatibility
– Works with most WooCommerce themes

Perfect For

  • Wholesale WooCommerce Stores
  • B2B eCommerce Websites
  • Membership-Based Pricing Stores
  • Catalog Mode WooCommerce Shops
  • Quote-Based Businesses
  • Private Online Stores

Use Cases

  • Hide prices for non-logged-in users
  • Create role-based pricing visibility
  • Convert WooCommerce into catalog mode
  • Replace Add to Cart with “Get a Quote”
  • Restrict purchasing for selected products

Hide Price and Add to Cart Lite for WooCommerce gives you full control over pricing visibility and purchasing functionality while keeping your store fast and flexible.
